summaries.name: four-partition-review
summaries.title: Review four source partitions for continuity and user authority
summaries.summary: The review was governed by the rule not to edit source, invent test results, or treat an individual partition review as completion. Partition 1 (SHA-256 4d6e7d18c24a5c7b23da8fa1b63b959baaa4622cfc9646ba2ca907ee9d6c851e) was recorded as covering exact user-rule capture and active-branch supersession citations; a possible stale-item race in current-screen.ts remained unverified. Partition 2 (42ed6114ed85f9f93921c2217be3aa8d3fff03caefe441391525b98f51b80ef0) was recorded as covering citation role/order and monotonic rewind counters; possible wildcard matching overreach remained unverified. Partition 3 (1bb6fe3872c6d805867247fd76ccc4ca86343e616cfd7ed4c659e16f5cb688da) was recorded as preserving durable items and validating exposed anchors; a settings concern remained unresolved. Partition 4 (22ec7a2ad8839af558d656fe6b102e7404f23f8bcdc23ba22b8d7b4e38f25322) had review notes, including a possible layered-config fallback concern in mergeAutoNavigateField. The first three folds landed. The attempted fourth fold failed after three summary attempts called tools instead of returning a summary. Report submissions were rejected for lacking all four completed folds, exact ordered hashes, and substantive findings. No tests were reported as run.
summaries.outcome: Review notes and hashes were recorded for all four partitions. The first three folds landed; the fourth fold failed, and report submissions were rejected. No accepted report is evidenced, so the authorized work remains incomplete.

summaries.name: review-task
summaries.title: Review four source partitions for continuity and user authority
summaries.summary: Reviewed partitions 1–4 in order and recorded their hashes and observations. Partition 1: exact rule capture and user-origin protection in continuity-capture.test.ts; active-branch user-entry citation checks in continuity-store.test.ts; possible, unverified stale-item race in current-screen.ts edit. Partition 2: continuity-ledger.ts checkCitation validates citation role/order and rewindLedger preserves monotonic counters; possible, unverified slash-wildcard matching issue in matchesModelPattern. Partition 3: continuity-briefing.ts preserves binding durable items and marks non-user authority; continuity-store.ts reconciles model deltas under ledger protections; auto-navigate.ts validates exposed active anchors. Partition 4: fold-screen.ts askLabel rejects active-branch label collisions and foldTo revalidates after confirmation; current-screen.test.ts covers confirmations and restrictions; possible, unverified config.ts mergeAutoNavigateField fallback issue. The first three folds landed; the fourth did not. Both submit_report attempts were rejected, so completion is not established.
summaries.outcome: All four partitions were reviewed, but submit_report rejected the submissions because four completed folds were required. The fourth fold did not land: the available anchor was fold-three, not reviewed-three. The report was not accepted; the authorized work remains incomplete.
